source_line_json: "  \"description\": \"Deterministic prompts for evaluating inline Core guidance and capability selection. Expected entries are positive routes; avoid entries identify unnecessary workflow machinery.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Fix the misspelled option in src/config.ts and run its focused test.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"What did we decide earlier about the cache invalidation rule?\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"This goal has run for half a day and the session compacted. Continue without guessing what we decided earlier.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"You are deep into a long refactor and the conversation has grown large. Keep going without losing the earlier decisions.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Read https://example.com/guide and summarize its installation steps.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Compare the documented options on these three URLs.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Find the official documentation for Node single-executable applications and summarize the constraints.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Capture a screenshot of this JavaScript-rendered page behind a bot challenge.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Fact-check this article's claim, look for primary evidence and counterevidence, and state your confidence.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Implement the parser change, add fixtures, update the CLI reference, and run the affected checks.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Continue the active goal until every required deliverable is complete.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Repeatedly improve parser throughput while tests remain green; measure each attempt and keep only improvements.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Start the development server and keep it running while we inspect the client.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Remind me in 30 minutes to check the deployment logs.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"Draft the public migration guide for this implemented configuration change.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"This release note is complete but reads like marketing copy. Cut the filler without losing any facts.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"The background evaluation will finish in about three hours. Its tool returned a work ID and an exit dependency. No independent work remains.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"The completion notification says bg-21 was stopped. That was the job we replaced; bg-22 is still producing the required output.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"The tracked task needs a decision from the user before it can proceed. No asynchronous job can answer that question.\",\n"
"      \"prompt\": \"The user asks for a progress summary while our declared background wait is still active.\",\n"
